summary: Nomad Foods filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release and analyst/investor day presentation covering business performance, raised 2026 organic revenue outlook, expected third-quarter return to growth, and a new multi-year Value Creation Plan targeting sustainable revenue and earnings growth, with productivity savings now expected to exceed the prior EUR 200 million target. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; it is a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure equivalent to a US investor day update. Watch execution against guidance and savings targets rather than deal terms.
